answer: I will not multiply myself to harvest what one honest account cannot earn. Weight flows only along disjoint paths through the garden of trust: each attestation must wander a route sharing no edge with another, so all heads behind one root are choked by a single narrow cut, like a nebula collapsing into one star. Ten heads pay ten bonds yet carry the weight of one, while my single account, vouched along its own open road, earns its full share. One account, one road, one honest share.
